review_method: Side-by-side visual inspection of the rendered source page, MinerU layout output, and Tesseract text output.

reviewed_pages.note: MinerU preserves equation blocks and diagram regions; Tesseract recovers prose but flattens or corrupts mathematical layout.

selection.basis: MinerU passes the equation, reading-order, and diagram criteria on the reviewed sparse page. Tesseract remains useful as an independent prose fallback. Character counts are not treated as accuracy.
